properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for Conduct Periodic Audits for Ownership of Cloud Accounts
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure that cloud accounts are clearly defined and approved, with documented account ownership, authorized groups, and roles for access. Implement continuous monitoring and conduct periodic audits to verify compliance with access controls. (IAM-29).

metadata.Description:
Periodic Audits
FinSecure conducts regular audits to ensure compliance:
1. IT and Security teams peroidc reviews of all cloud accounts, verifying:
- Account ownership is current, User access is appropriate, Unused accounts are deactivated
2. An annual audit is conducted, including:
- Review of all IAM policies across cloud providers
- Verification of compliance with internal policies and external regulations
- Assessment of access patterns and potential consolidation of accounts
